# GitHub Workflows

This directory contains GitHub Actions workflows for the TSV Rudow Foerderverein website project.

## Workflows

- build.yml
  - Builds documentation artifacts (diagrams and PDFs)
  - Runs on pushes and pull requests

- deploy.yml
  - Deploys static site content when configured

- static.yml
  - Additional static pipeline checks for repository automation

## Notes

Project documentation and product overview are maintained in the root README:

- ../README.md

This file is intentionally limited to workflow context to avoid duplication.
